{{- /* quartz/taxonomy-title.html — page title for , og:title and the taxonomy h1. Input: page. Foundry gives taxonomy list pages the singular key as .Title ("tag", "category"), so name those lists "Tags" / "Categories" (i18n). Every other page returns .Title unchanged. */ -}} {{- $t := .Title -}} {{- if eq .Kind "taxonomy" -}} {{- $k := lower (printf "%v" .Title) -}} {{- if or (eq $k "tag") (eq $k "tags") -}}{{- $t = i18n "tags.title" | default "Tags" -}} {{- else if or (eq $k "category") (eq $k "categories") -}}{{- $t = i18n "categories.title" | default "Categories" -}} {{- else -}}{{- $t = $k | humanize | title -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $t -}}
